blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Bear Creek Green Timbers fell from 40 in June to 37 in September (−7.5%), and 15 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 2.4% of Surrey’s 1,523 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Bear Creek Green Timbers?
Bear Creek Green Timbers also had 93 houses listed and 5 sold in September, against 37 condos and townhomes listed. The Bear Creek Green Timbers houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Bear Creek Green Timbers?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 37 condos and townhomes listed in Bear Creek Green Timbers. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Bear Creek Green Timbers a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Bear Creek Green Timbers had a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Bear Creek Green Timbers from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 15 condos and townhomes sold in Bear Creek Green Timbers over those 4 months, out of 591 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
